title: We Are All Rabbaniyeen; Be Not Divided
body:
Listen! This is a humble and weak servant, but I have been ordered to deliver this message, so I have
delivered you the message. And I am innocent from all those groups of people who are denying this message.
And the consequence of denying will be a sharp sword from malakoot, which will cut their heads. I don’t have
anything to say to them.
I don’t like Egypt to have groups called, Ikhwan al-Muslimeen or Salafiyya. I like mu’mins to be called as
Allah jalla wa `aala has said in the Holy Qur’an, “Wa laakin koonoo rabbaniyeen.”
••• ••••• •••••••• ••• •••••••••• •••••• •••••••••• ••••••••••• •••••••••••••• ••••• ••••••• ••••••••• •••••••• •••••••• ••••

Maa kaana li-basharin an yu'teeyahullahu ’l-kitaaba wa al-hukma wa 'n-nuboowwata thumma yaqoola li 'nnaasi koonoo `ibaadan lee min doonillahi wa laakin koonoo rabbaniyyeena bimaa kuntum tu`allimoona ’lkitaba wa bimaa kuntum tadrusoona. No human to whom Allah has given the (Holy) Book, Judgment, and
prophethood would say to the people, "Be worshippers of me, other than Allah," but rather (they would
say),"Be of the Lord, for that you teach the Book, and in that you have studied." (Ali Imran, 3:79)
Allah (swt) teaches us not to separate but to be together and leave all these groups which you yourselves have

created. Salafi, Wahhabi, Ikhwan al-Muslimeen, Ikhwan ash-Shayateen: You have named all of these
yourselves. Allah says in Holy Qur’an, unzhuroo: wa laakin koonoo rabbaniyeen. “Allah likes His servant to
be Rabbaniyeen.”
O Muslims of Egypt! Say, “We are Rabbaniyeen,” so that the hearts of Ikhwan al-Muslimeen and Salafiyoon
start to tremble! If asked, “Who are you?” say, “I am Rabbani, mu`min.”
O Ikhwan al-Muslimeen! Leave this imitated title as it has no value. In the sight of people, you are as under
their feet, but if you want honor and dignity here and in the Hereafter, then follow the words of Allah, where
He Almighty says, koonoo rabbaniyeen, “Be of the Lord.” And I am Rabbani, poor and weak, but I try to be
among the Rabbaniyeen, Muslim Rabbani.
O People of Egypt! Say, “We are Rabbani Muslims.” Close down the Ikhwan al-Muslim; it does not have any
taste. But call people to say, “We are Muslimeen Rabbaniyeen.” This is how you will be saved. With this, you
will be accepted in the Earth and in the Heavens, but be Rabbaniyeen. This is my madhhab! This has come to
me and I have been ordered to tell you. There is nothing in Islam such as “Wahhabi,” “Salafi,” “Ikhwan alMuslimeen,” “Shi`a,” and all others, no! But Allah orders to be Rabbani. Leave Shi`aism and say, “I am
Rabbani.” Leave Ikhwan al-Muslimeen and say, “Muslim Rabbani.” And all Salafis, say, “I am not Salafi.”
What is “Salafi”? No taste! Say the blessed name, “I am Muslim Rabbani.”
O Lord, forgive us! O Lord, teach us. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. If there is any human being
in Islam who points that I am wrong, I submit my soul to my Lord. You will not find anyone (truthful) who
denies these words. I am nothing. SubhaanAllah, the Lord of Heavens and the Earth! O Lord, forgive us
and have mercy on us and send us a king who will fight for the sake of Allah!
Fatihah.
Anyone who denies these words, the second day he will be in the graveyard. I have the complete authority (to
make that happen). Anyone who denies my words will not reach the blessed coming days, finished. Because
the Saif ul-Qahhar, “the Subduing Sword from Heavens” that will cut their heads and not leave any of them!
So let them be stubborn and continue to practice.

O Arabs! The Prophet (s) permitted churches and synagogues to thrive in safety and peace and he said not to
hurt them. It is from Mankind’s evilness to destroy churches, which is outside the limits of Islam. They are
people of responsibility; their blood, land and money is forbidden for us. But the ignorant, I warn them: if
they work against (this declaration) they will not reach a similar day until akhirah.
Laa ilaaha ill-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah (s)! Yaa Sayyidi 'l-awwaleen wa ’l-akhireen. `Ishfaa lana, yaa
Rasoolullah. `Ishfaa lana, yaa Rasoolullah.
Fatihah.
